item.title: Anthony Joshua Involved in Fatal Road Accident on Lagos–Ibadan Expressway
item.description: British heavyweight boxing star Anthony Joshua was involved in a tragic road traffic accident in Nigeria on Monday, which claimed the lives of two people.The crash occurred along the Lagos–Ibadan Expressway in Ogun State when the vehicle Joshua was travelling in collided with a stationary truck. Joshua, who was a passenger at the time, sustained injuries, though they are not considered life-threatening. Emergency services responded promptly, but two individuals were pronounced dead at the scene.
